subject.title: fix(channels): honor configured read target policies

question: Should `conversationReadOrigin: "direct-operator"` remain a public operator-write RPC and plugin contract, or should direct authority be derived entirely from server-known ingress?
rationale: Both shapes can be implemented safely, but choosing the permanent trust and compatibility boundary requires owner intent rather than code-only inference.

options.title: Approve the public operation marker
options.body: Keep the literal marker for authenticated operator-write calls, with agent runtimes forced delegated and compatibility tests for older clients and plugins.

options.title: Derive authority server-side
options.body: Remove the public authority input and infer direct-operator status solely from trusted endpoint and client identity.

options.title: Split provider fixes first
options.body: Land independently provable provider corrections and defer the shared Gateway and plugin SDK authority contract.

recommendation.title: Approve the public operation marker
recommendation.body: Keep the literal marker for authenticated operator-write calls, with agent runtimes forced delegated and compatibility tests for older clients and plugins.

likelyOwner.reason: Prior merged security, Gateway, plugin, and channel work makes this the strongest available individual routing candidate for coordinating the owner decision.
